entities.name: Viashino
entities.description: Humanoid lizard-folk descended from dragons who appear on many planes, including Jund, Capenna, Dominaria and Ravnica.

entities.name: Manytooth Thrash
entities.description: A Jund viashino thrash that prides itself on the might and viciousness of its warriors.

entities.name: Palehide Thrash
entities.description: A Jund viashino thrash that prides itself on slaying humans, led by Igh.

entities.name: Igh
entities.description: The old, brittle-scaled leader of the Palehide Thrash who claims to have slain three hundred humans.

entities.name: Pitch Thrash
entities.description: A viashino thrash ruling the tar pits known as the Seethe.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: The Alaran shard where viashino have a crocodilian form and live in thrashes.

entities.name: Shivan Nation
entities.description: The union formed by the viashino, goblins, Ghitu and Shivan dragons.

entities.name: Terrent Amese
entities.description: The figure said to have created the viashino of Dominaria.

entities.name: Riveteers
entities.description: A Capennan crime family led by Ziatora that many viashino join.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: The main home of Dominarian viashino civilization.

events.summary: After the Conflux the viashino of Jund confront their primitive counterparts on Naya.
events.quote: the Viashino of Jund were confronted by their primitive, beastly, counterparts on Naya

events.summary: The Dominarian viashino survive the Ice Age by hiding within the Mana Rig.
events.quote: the viashino survived the Ice Age by hiding within the Mana Rig

events.summary: Viashino, goblins, Ghitu and Shivan dragons form the Shivan Nation.
events.quote: The four species have now formed the Shivan Nation together.

relations.quote: Their leader is an old, brittle-scaled viashino named Igh

relations.note: Said to have created the viashino of Dominaria.
relations.quote: viashino are said to have been created by Terrent Amese

relations.note: Viashino are one of the four species in the nation.
relations.quote: The four species have now formed the Shivan Nation together.
This thrash rules a vast network of low-lying tar pits known as the Seethe.
